records.context: THE ONE PLACE A NON-MATPLOTLIB RENDERER CAN ASK. ``save_figure`` rewrites the extension itself, which is why every matplotlib save has honoured the preference for months -- but pyqtgraph decides what it writes FROM THE NAME (``FastPlot.export`` branches on ``.pdf`` / ``.svg`` / else), so a renderer that is handed ``volcano.pdf`` writes a PDF whatever the user chose. The name has to be settled before the export sees it, and settling it twice in two modules is how the two drift apart.
records.label: spacr.plot.figure_path#1
records.source: THE ONE PLACE A NON-MATPLOTLIB RENDERER CAN ASK. ``save_figure`` rewrites the extension itself, which is why every matplotlib save has honoured the preference for months -- but pyqtgraph decides what it writes FROM THE NAME (``FastPlot.export`` branches on ``.pdf`` / ``.svg`` / else), so a renderer that is handed ``volcano.pdf`` writes a PDF whatever the user chose. The name has to be settled before the export sees it, and settling it twice in two modules is how the two drift apart.
records.translation: 非 MATPLOTLIB 渲染器唯一可以询问的地方。 ``save_figure`` 会自行改写扩展名，这就是为什么几个月来每一次 matplotlib 保存都遵循了这项偏好 -- 但 pyqtgraph 是根据文件名来决定写出什么的 ( ``FastPlot.export`` 按 ``.pdf`` / ``.svg`` / 其他情况分支 )，所以拿到 ``volcano.pdf`` 的渲染器无论用户选了什么都会写出 PDF。文件名必须在导出看到它之前就确定下来，而在两个模块里各确定一次，正是两者逐渐不一致的原因。

records.context: Github is the exception, and deliberately. GitHub publishes the Octocat's path data for use as a link mark, so that one is the real thing rather than a circle with ears -- still a path, still recoloured per theme, still nothing added to the wheel.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.provider_marks#5
records.source: GITHUB IS THE EXCEPTION, and deliberately. GitHub publishes the Octocat's path data for use as a link mark, so that one is the real thing rather than a circle with ears -- still a path, still recoloured per theme, still nothing added to the wheel.
records.translation: GITHUB 是例外，而且是有意为之。GitHub 公开了 Octocat 的路径数据，供用作链接标记，所以这一个是真正的标志，而不是一个带耳朵的圆 -- 它仍然是路径，仍然按主题重新着色，也仍然没有往安装包里加任何东西。
